description: Search meetings by summary text, name, action items, and decisions. Transcripts are not searched — use get_meeting for those. Returns ranked results with snippets.

query.description: Search query. Case-insensitive. Every word must appear somewhere in the searched fields, but they need not share a field. Words match as substrings ("export" finds "exporter"). Wrap words in double quotes to require them as an exact phrase.

name: search_meetings
